crossRefs.note: Five of you shall chase a hundred, and a hundred of you shall chase ten thousand; and your enemies shall fall before…
How could one chase a thousand, and two put ten thousand to flight, unless their Rock had sold them, and Yahweh had…

translations.web: These of the sons of Gad were captains of the army: he who was least was equal to one hundred, and the greatest to one thousand.
translations.bsb: These Gadites were army commanders, the least of whom was a match for a hundred, and the greatest for a thousand.
translations.kjv: These were of the sons of Gad, captains of the host: one of the least was over an hundred, and the greatest over a thousand.
translations.asv: These of the sons of Gad were captains of the host: he that was least was equal to a hundred, and the greatest to a thousand.
